what: First-open curtain — a vertical pledge text in the center of a background-color curtain turns on .2s in over .4s, and after .8s the curtain’s top-left edge (S curve) carries a small bird out past the bottom-right of the screen: first segment .72s easeInCubic accelerating, then .08, .1, .36s straight (phone .6 · .08 · .2s). The logo on the faint board behind the curtain is revealed, fades out .2s after .6s, and the board lifts away over .4s easeOutQuad — about 3s on wide screens until fully cleared

options.speed: Multiplier for all durations and delays, default 1 — .5 makes it twice as fast
options.hold: Wait before the edges start moving (s), default .8
options.event: Event name sent to document when unveiling starts (for chaining later motion)
options.lock: false means scrolling is not blocked while spinning (by default fx-curve-sweep-lock is added to html)
options.[data-fx-part=edge]: S-curve SVG inside the curtain (viewBox 500×596, filled side on the right) — a single path
options.[data-fx-part=rider]: (If any) Image burned into the edge (bird)
options.[data-fx-part=logo]: (If any) Logo centered on the panel behind the curtain
options.[data-fx-part=copy]: (If any) centered text over the veil

use:
Logo
Bird
Pledge post

from.where: shared.js .sk-first (first open of every page — original init.js pageLoadFirst: mask top/left after a delay of 800, (x·.25, y·.5) 720ms easeInCubic → (·.35, ·.65) 80ms → (·.6, ·.85) 100ms → (x, y) 360ms linear, x = Window width+520 · y = Window height + 50, no phone = Width+340 · y = Height .85 with 600·80·200ms. copy img 400ms (delay 200) on · 200ms (delay 600) off, logo 200ms (delay 600) off, #loading-first 400ms easeOutQuad)

note: The curtain’s S-curve edge is redrawn as a path from the silhouette of the original mask-loading.png. Since it makes people wait, for screens that are skipped often, shorten it with speed.
